headerDisplay: Event-driven Homebridge plugin for Alarm.com-backed security systems (ADT Control, ADT Command, ADT+, Brinks, and others). Use the Sign in panel above to enter credentials and (if enabled) capture a 2FA trusted-device cookie. The settings below control what gets exposed to HomeKit and a few advanced overrides.
footerDisplay: On first run the plugin sets up its own private Python environment under the Homebridge storage dir, downloading a portable CPython 3.13 if your host doesn't already have one. No system Python setup required.

username.title: Email
username.description: Managed by the Sign in panel above.

password.title: Password
password.description: Managed by the Sign in panel above.

exposeSecurityPanel.title: Expose Security Panel
exposeSecurityPanel.description: Exposes the alarm panel as a HomeKit Security System accessory.

armAwayKeypadBypass.title: Bypass open zones when arming
armAwayKeypadBypass.description: When Home.app requests Arm, faulted zones will be bypassed. Leave off for most setups.

mfaCookie.title: 2FA Remember-Me Cookie (manual override)
mfaCookie.description: Normally captured automatically by the Sign in panel above. Only edit if you have a cookie from another tool.

pythonPath.title: Python executable path
pythonPath.description: Override the auto-detected Python 3.13+ binary. Leave blank for auto-detect.

items.description: These settings are not required for most users.
